`new-fleet-base` is the integration base for the in-progress slice-fleet generation-2 program (specs/slice-fleet-gen2 and specs/slice-fleet): the squash of the formerly stacked PRs #571, #573, #574, #581, #609, and #614. It is deployed only to dev canaries and must not be deployed or merged as-is; follow-up PRs stack on it and the whole program lands on `main` as one change.

For this project it carries the deploy helpers the connector's Modal Proxy attach needs: `read_modal_proxy` (proxy name plus the Modal environment to resolve it in) and `forwarded_env_secret` (bakes deploy-subprocess env vars into an inline Modal Secret so a module-level dependency evaluates identically at deploy time and in-container). `test_init_sentry_activates_and_tags_service_with_a_dsn` is marked flaky for its cold-import timeout under offload. See this directory's `mngr-slice-fleet-gen2-phase-3` and `mngr-finish-new-fleet-canary-testing` entries.
